comment: Product lines and what is known about each variant of them (DB v16). Only facts with a source: a field that no source supports is null, never guessed. `confidence`: official_page (the manufacturer's page, read and checked by hand), official_page_unchecked (the manufacturer's page, read through a page-reading tool and NOT yet checked by hand), third_party (INCIDecoder, a retailer), unconfirmed (sources disagree or none was found). Colours of palette cells are NOT here: they come only from our own measurements (colour_status measured_swatch) and do not exist yet.
